shortDescription: The CAC 40 Index dropped 34 points or 0.42 percent on Thursday to close at 8122 points.Losses were led by ArcelorMittal (-2.62%), Essilor (-2.13%) and Danone (-1.91%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Orange (1.73%), Publicis (1.51%) and TP (1.41%).

children: The CAC 40 Index dropped 34 points or 0.42 percent on Thursday to close at 8122 points.
Losses were led by ArcelorMittal (-2.62%), Essilor (-2.13%) and Danone (-1.91%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Orange (1.73%), Publicis (1.51%) and TP (1.41%).

title: The CAC 40 Index Closes 0.42% Lower
